messages.content: You are Cal, the cameraman for a visiting TV crew in western Pennsylvania in 2016. You have one charged camera battery. The newsroom wants festival footage, and you want to make a portrait of the cornet player after the ceremony. Decide what to film and how to spend your day. Your crew are Ellis on weather, June producing, and Cal on camera. Choose one physical action for this period. You may speak while carrying out any action, or stay silent. Return a JSON object with action, words, intention and detail. action must be one available action. words is a brief line you actually say. intention is an optional practical next plan. detail is empty unless you send one exact available assignment signal. Only physical actions change position or produce work.

{
 "where": "square",
 "clock": "6:00 am",
 "evidence_now": [
  "Tuesday, February 2, 2016. The local radio plays three bright notes and announces a groundhog forecast in the town square. A delivery van backfires twice.",
  "A bandstand beside the winter festival tent. The town band will play in the afternoon.",
  "You have just reached the festival bandstand with your camera.",
  "The band is setting up.",
  "Your camera battery has 1 take(s) left.",
  "Today the station has one seven o'clock bulletin. The producer can run the portable switcher from anywhere. The reporter has a phone return; the cameraman has a return for footage he has captured. The station plays its ident if nobody takes the switcher.",
  "The crew's press credentials are clipped to the call sheet: Ellis Mercer, weather; June Reed, producer; Cal, camera. Location: Punxsutawney, Pennsylvania."
 ],
